title: test(driver-sql): sql-driver-connect-bound runs under the 10 s budget (#23182 row 6)
body:
Part of #23182 (row 6)

Row 6 of the test-budget card: `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-connect-bound.test.ts`, read at 10.5 s in the hourly full battery (run 38228297391). Test-only change, one file. The seat closes the card; this PR does not.

## Where the time went

One test of sixteen: `actually bounds a query against a black-holing endpoint` waited out the driver's real 10 s pg `connectionTimeoutMillis` against a loopback listener that accepts the socket and never answers. That is 10,014-10,015 ms of the file's 10.14-10.20 s of test time (3 runs, alone). The other fifteen tests total about 0.2 s.

The 10 s is the production default (`DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`, a private static with no seam), and the card's limits forbid shortening the bound the test pins. PR #23730 (the sqlite connect fail-fast) changed only the sqlite connect path in `sql-driver.ts`, not the pg bound this test waits on: re-measured on current main, the wait is unchanged. So the fix is the test's clock, not production.

## What changed

- The listener stays real (same loopback black hole). A new `accepted` promise settles when the server holds the first socket.
- `setTimeout` and `clearTimeout` are faked for the test body only (`vi.useFakeTimers` with an explicit `toFake`; `net` I/O, microtasks and `Date` stay real). pg arms `connectionTimeoutMillis` and tarn arms `createTimeoutMillis` on the faked `setTimeout`.
- The test does not move the clock until the server has accepted the socket, then advances it in 500 ms steps (each followed by a real macrotask yield) until the query settles, never past 20 s.
- Real timers are restored in `finally`, before `afterEach` disconnects the driver.
- The per-test timeout goes from 40,000 to 15,000 ms: it only has to bound a hung run now. Lowered, not raised.
- The two settlement outcomes are tracked explicitly, so a query that resolves is reported as "resolved but should have failed", not as "still pending".

## Every pinned behaviour stays pinned

Same assertions on the black-hole test: message contains `timeout expired`, message does not contain `pool is probably full`, elapsed greater than 8,000 and less than 20,000. Elapsed is now the fake clock's advance, which is exact: it read 10,000 in 3 probe runs against the unmodified driver (a scratch copy printing it, deleted after). Two assertions are added: one that the query settled within 20 s of fake time (what an unbounded connect fails), one that it did not resolve. The other fifteen tests are byte-identical. Tests 16 to 16; `expect(` calls 26 to 28. No test deleted, no `.skip`/`.todo`, no project change.

## Before and after

Method: the file alone, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --reporter=verbose`, through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, 3 runs each, dependency closure built first. A shared box, so read the ratios.

| | tests (vitest `tests` figure) | black-hole test | file `Duration` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| base `9d4fb3c306` | 10.20 / 10.15 / 10.14 s | 10,015 / 10,014 / 10,014 ms | 19.97 / 20.12 / 20.54 s |
| this branch, head `470d1ad3a1` | 131 / 136 / 132 ms | 20 / 21 / 20 ms | 9.47 / 9.46 / 9.32 s |

The remaining `Duration` is vitest's cold module-graph load, not test time: `import` 8.8-9.0 s and `transform` 7.2-7.4 s on this box (not attributed further here). It cannot be what the card's 10.5 s reading counts (that reading is the 10.01 s black-hole test plus about 0.5 s), so it is outside this row.

## Ablation

Mutations land on `sql-driver.ts` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode; each leg proved on disk: anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, then restored with blob equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty). The subject is imported as `./sql-driver.js`, which resolves to source, so there is no `dist/` leg. Each ablation was run against the base test (a scratch copy, deleted after) and this branch's test in one run; failures below are the black-hole test's.

| mutation | base test | this branch |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A: `DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS` 10_000 to 5_000 | red, `expected 5007 to be greater than 8000` (5.0 s) | red, `expected 5000 to be greater than 8000` (32 ms) |
| B: dialect timeout injection disabled (`dialect` forced undefined) | red, `expected 'Knex: Timeout acquiring a connection.…' to contain 'timeout expired'` (15.0 s) | red, same message (20 ms) |
| C: `withConnectBound` bypassed (no bound at all) | red, same Knex message (30.0 s) | red, `still pending after 20s of fake time — the connect is unbounded` (46 ms) |

Whole-file counts under each: A 5 failed of 16, B 5 of 16, C 8 of 16 on this branch (the extra failures are the config-shape pins in the same file, identical on base). Control, unmutated: 32 of 32 across both files. Not ablated: the `resolved but should have failed` guard (no cheap production mutation makes a connect to a silent socket succeed).

## Verification (head `470d1ad3a1`)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck`: exit 0; `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` lists the test file once (the package has no test-typecheck ledger).
- eslint, `--no-inline-config`, on the changed file: 1 file, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (51) plus every artifact-roster family (53) plus every declared wide-population family (11): 114 unique commands, run at this head, recorded with exit codes. 108 exit 0. Two exited 3 on a missing `dist/` (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`); after `turbo run build` (75 tasks, 74 cached) both re-ran exit 0. Four roster gates need pull-request context and answered NOT MEASURED locally: `check-closing-target-claim.mjs` (exit 2), `pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (exit 1, no event payload), `check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` (exit 2; re-run below with this body), `check-single-claim-paths.mjs` (exit 2). Their workflows run on the PR.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` over the coded record: 51 derived families accounted for, 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 51 recorded an exit code, none is 3).
- No changeset: the published `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and the built `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs` carry none of the test's identifiers. `skip-changeset` is applied through `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` after opening.
- Not measured: CI wall for the file on a runner (the hourly battery is the pin; the next refresh PR's list no longer naming the file).
